questions.question: What differs between none and a disabled extension?
questions.answer: The none preset keeps explicit overrides. The enabled false setting stops instructions, catalogs, automatic hooks, and automatic mutation collection.

questions.question: How does a user pause a session without removal of explicit overrides?
questions.answer: Use slopsentral set session with enabled false in the complete layer. Keep the other fields because the command replaces the layer.

questions.question: Which routes load skills and which values does the model supply?
questions.answer: The human uses slopsentral skill NAME. The model supplies name and the advertised generation to slopsentral_skill.

questions.question: What action resolves a changed resource?
questions.answer: Use reload to capture new resource bytes. A valid settings replacement also captures new bytes.

questions.question: What does a successful load fail to prove?
questions.answer: The load does not prove model compliance or workflow completion. Unrestricted read and bash can still read Markdown. Transport labels do not authenticate a human.

corrections.reason: The review needed a concrete pause command and its layer-replacement limit.
corrections.action: Added the command and an instruction to keep the other fields.
